reviews.x: This is the first organic mascara I have used. I didn't want to spend a ton of money, but wanted to protect my eyes from harmful chemicals. I honestly didn't expect to like this mascara as much as I do. It's not going to give you Kardashian style lashes, but the color is good, and it goes on smoothly, giving your eyes good definition. The wand is a good size, soft, and full of bristles. It doesn't clump. If you don't build a ton of product on, one wandful can cover both eyes, which impressed me.

I've tried a couple of different "natural" mascaras and they all do the same thing.

reviews.t: Nice consistency but not water resistant enough
reviews.x: At first I was pretty happy with the consistency of this mascara. It applies smoothly and doesn't clump. It looks nice on the lashes. However, I was really hoping it would be more resistant to water. I was ideally looking for an organic mascara that is waterproof, but have yet to find one so I gave this 'water resistant' one a shot. If your eyes tear, it will definitely smear across your eye area. I'm fed up with how many times it has gotten smudged. I had to stop using this after a while.

Smells delicious! That was a nice surprise! It also works JUST AS WELL as any top brand mascara I've bought in recent years. And it's better for my lashes/eyes. This is a no brainer folks. Side note: because it's not waterproof it tends to drift onto skin when applied to lower lashes. This is not a big issue to me considering how lovely the product is in every way. Made my lashes thick and pretty!

I used it for the first time today and like it very much.  It went on quite easily, seems to stay on all day without smudges,  and did not make my eyes feel irritated the way most other brands have done..

claims.text: Many reviewers find the mascara goes on smoothly and easily, with good color and lash separation.
Several reviewers appreciate that it is gentle on sensitive eyes and causes little to no irritation.
A common complaint is that it smudges, flakes, or runs, especially since it is not waterproof.
Some reviewers report clumping or thickening issues, including with the wand or over time.
Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant fruity smell and the reasonable price.
